siteAbout: a free planning calendar of corporate case competitions for Indian MBA students (run by companies like HUL, ITC, L'Oreal, Tata, Mahindra, Deloitte), organised by the month they usually open.
dataHeader: The B-school case-comp data. Edited by hand and by the weekly updater (scripts/update.mjs).

fieldDocs.mo: number 1-12, the month registrations usually open
fieldDocs.window: short text, when it usually runs, e.g. 'Aug–Sep'. Use 'Dormant (last run 2022)' if it has stopped
fieldDocs.edition: short text, latest edition and year, e.g. 'S18 = 2026'. Start with 'Dormant' if no edition in the last two seasons
fieldDocs.blurb: one or two plain sentences on what it is; only change if facts are now wrong
fieldDocs.unstop: the Unstop page URL for the current or latest edition

livePrompt: This site lists CORPORATE case competitions for MBA students: competitions run or sponsored by a company (HUL, ITC, Tata, L'Oreal, Deloitte, a bank, an FMCG or tech firm), usually with PPIs or PPOs. Pick the open Unstop listings that are corporate competitions an MBA student would want. Leave out college-fest events run by a student club unless a company is the named sponsor of that specific competition.
addPrompt: Find corporate case competitions for Indian MBA students that are missing from our list: run by a company (not a college fest), held in India or open to Indian B-schools, with a 2025 or 2026 edition.
